protocol: Stopped both applications before each launch, waited three seconds, launched MainActivity via MAIN/LAUNCHER. No video played in these observation windows. measurement: Deduplicated actual-present timestamps (second column) separately in each SurfaceFlinger --latency snapshot of the CV10 output surface. Reported median of rolling windows after the first four seconds. Collections overlap; the method avoids counting time between disjoint captures. Startup and thermal/loading variability remain visible in raw windows.
